bandwidth_definition: R2 section2.1: central-valley component must include both inner peaks; external components separate
uniqueness_definition: R2 section2.2: >1% relative parameter difference AND <=1.05 cost ratio; >=5 independent seeds
evidence: offline extraction of supplied data; not solver/visual certification

circuit.uniqueness_rule: R2: any parameter relative-to-best difference >1%; another solution cost <=1.05*best
circuit.basin_label_rule: cost-ordered representatives, max componentwise relative difference <=1%; descriptive labels; decision always compares each start directly with best
circuit.initialization_policy: Five independent seeds; legacy seed fit may additionally initialize one refinement and is not a sixth independent seed.
circuit.fit_target: abs(S11),2-11.5GHz; phase and S21 not fitted
